_doc: D3-01 P5 heist casts, extended in D-115 to the four pre-P5 heists (ENV D). heist -> role -> [character ids]; each id's scene is res://world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn (characters.json lists them). P5 roles are generic names; the D-115 heists (glasshouse, night_deposit, dockside_burn, shadow_ledger) are keyed by the spawn tags in the design doc's roster table (docs/design/heists/<heist>.md, '### ... roster (spawn data)'), so ENV A's NpcVisualTweak.heist_tag_characters can mirror them 1:1; the camera operator is security_operator (CAMERA_OPERATOR spawn) and 'police' is the director's police roster. Reused ids are D1/D2 characters cast again (D-063 reserved the tellers, guests and waitress for P5). Faction-variant ids (<id>_frd|_sentinel|_zero) are picked per difficulty by EnemyDef.params.visual_variant (characters.md v1.6), so only the base ids are listed. tag_map.<heist> (GN-D1) is the spawn tag -> [ids] map ENV A mirrors 1:1 into NpcVisualTweak.heist_tag_characters for heists whose roles above are generic (gallery_night); its ids come from that heist's roles. pager_roles lists the P5 pager roles only. Hand-maintained by ENV D; checked by game/tests/d/test_p5_cast.gd.

notes.gallery_night: Halberd Gallery Security is the gallery's in-house guard (bottle-green blazer, Halberd crest), not Halden or Northgate. The curator is the keycard carrier and the one pale suit at the gala. GN-D1 polish: nine distinct patron looks (five women, four men, evening wear in dark or jewel tones) for up to nine live patrons, twelve since D-130 (gallery_patron_h-j: seven women, five men, for Cataclysm's +35 % civilians); two attendant looks (man in the waistcoat, woman in the jacket); two waitstaff (npc_penthouse_staff the waitress, gallery_waiter in the wine waistcoat); D-130 gala_extra (cloakroom waitstaff + drawings-cabinet attendant): a third look in each pool, gallery_waiter_b (cloakroom: woman, 50s, short wine waiter jacket, no apron) and gallery_attendant_c (drawings cabinet: man, about 50, grey knit cardigan, cotton gloves, staff lanyard); the conservator has his own work-wear look (gallery_conservator: knit vest, canvas apron, loupe) instead of reusing gallery_attendant_b. D-130: one pool of nine Halberd guard faces, twelve since the Cataclysm inspection (up to 11 guards) (gallery_guard a-l: six women, six men; blazer or shirtsleeve waistcoat order) on every guard tag (hall, rovers, mews, operator, inspection), so Cataclysm's extra guards are never twins. Insurance inspectors wear the Halberd livery (QC-58d); the Vaultline couriers are armored_car_crew/_b.
notes.ostrander_federal: Ostrander Federal (D-075). Tellers keep the D2-02 bank livery and the new day manager (keycard carrier) matches it; the gallery-level loan/accounts officers (D-075) wear grey suits with the bank's red lanyard and ID badge. Guards are Halden Security: the day officers (peaked cap) and the bare-headed night guard (camera operator). civilian_customer_b is the elderly customer; bank_customer_b is the parent with a backpack. OF-D1 (D-130, an L heist: up to 6 guards + the operator, 4 tellers, 3 officers and 13 customers/clients at Cataclysm): tag_map.ostrander_federal is the spawn tag -> ids map ENV A mirrors. One pool of ten Halden faces (security_officer a-j) on every guard post, the D-140 extra guards (guard_extra_hall / _basement) included; the operator stays npc_bank_guard. guard_vip is security_bodyguard (Halden close protection: charcoal suit, earpiece, Halden pin) and civ_vip is bank_vip_client, both only for the rare vip_client. Tellers npc_bank_teller a-e, officers bank_officer a-d (also the safe-deposit attendant, civ_sd_attendant, seated at the SD desk: the same pool, so with the three officers it never twins), and one pool of twelve customer faces (bank_customer a-j, civilian_customer_a/b) shared by the hall, the plaza and the private-client lounge. The day manager is Lionel Ashgrove (bank_manager) on every manager route; the Vaultline couriers are armored_car_crew/_b.
notes.rolling_thunder: The crew works for Vaultline Armored Transport (original). The escort is the police/TAC roster plus its frd/sentinel/zero reskins by difficulty; no new escort model. RT-D1 (up to three trucks, a driver and a custodian each, D-130): six Vaultline crew faces (armored_car_crew a-f, two women) on every truck cab (convoy_t1-3), and the route marshal armored_car_marshal (QC-86: the crew uniform under a Vaultline-amber hi-vis vest, never the police yellow) on vl_marshal; both carry pagers. Site guards are Halden (security_officer a-j), the beat cop patrol_officer. Pedestrians and the bus queue share the street pool: the twelve OF day faces plus the nine RT street pedestrians a-i (v15, prep/d-rt; g-i are finish-only swaps of a / b / f, D-147, so the top roll of 21 live has no twins); civ_diner (seated, sit_eat) = the street pool minus the 7 back-bag looks (their bags would cross a chair / booth back: cower_offsets lists them), 14 looks; staff_diner = the diner waitress and cook (staff_waitress / staff_cook, first in those spawns' tags, pin each look to its spawn), staff_booth = the car-park attendant; driver_mixer = Hollis "Hammer" Reyes (contact_hollis_rt, RT-G3: the fixer drives the ram mixer himself, sit_vehicle_drive in the cab, dressed for the site in an orange hi-vis work jacket, rigger gloves and a radio handset; the briefing bust keeps contact_hollis).
notes.afterhours: Staff wear black and the Velvet's violet; patrons are mixed club wear. Every bouncer's Hip/Socket is on his radio (club_bouncer: clipped outside the bomber waistband; the others: the belt). D-165 special roles: club_offduty (civ_offduty, the rare off_duty_cop) is a plain-clothes look (black leather jacket over a grey henley, jeans, the gold belt badge and holster as the tell) instead of frd_agent's FRD windbreaker; club_vip (vip_party's +6 VIP patrons) is its own six-look pool (a birthday host with an ivory sash, five guests, all with a gold VIP wristband) so the party never twins the floor; club_courier (cartel_courier, co_op_pickup) is the Ortega Co-op gunmen (QC-36) minus the face-covered looks (b, f, g), so the two couriers walk in bare-faced.
notes.glasshouse: Golden Hour (D-115). Guards and the operator are Halden: since the D-140 twins audit one pool of ten faces (security_officer a-j) on every guard post and the operator (ENV A pools them), and civ_customer draws twelve customer faces (bank_customer a-j, civilian_customer_a/b), so neither repeats. Greta Vossberg (owner/manager, rare nervous_manager) is civilian_manager_vossberg; the two associates are told apart (civilian_sales at the counter, civilian_sales_b on the floor); the upstairs admin clerk wears civilian_clerk office wear, not the shop-floor dress. Customers add the Ostrander bank_customer looks for variety. Guard tags and the operator are not in the roster table: they come from the guard_post variant table and the CameraOperatorSeat spawn.
notes.night_deposit: Nightfall Depository (D-115). Halden on the floor (D-116: four faces security_officer a-d; D-130: six faces a-f for Cataclysm's extra guards, two women; one pool for hall, basement and rovers); the seated operator is the bare-headed Halden night guard (npc_bank_guard). Cleaners (civ_cleaner, D-130): npc_bank_cleaner (man, buzz cut) and npc_bank_cleaner_b (woman, brown bun), the same contractor uniform. The night manager (code carrier) is npc_bank_night_manager (bank livery, D2-02). The armored_car_early guards are the Vaultline crew (guard_armored_car, from the rare-event table, not the roster).
notes.dockside_burn: Dockside Burn (D-115). Co-op cartel gunmen on every cartel post (EnemyDef enemy.cartel_gunman visual_alternates), one pool of twelve faces cartel_gunman a-l (D-115 DB cast: up to 12 posted at Cataclysm, no twins; three women, slung long gun on six); night-shift workers are the dock crew (civ_worker: dock_worker, dock_worker_b and dock_worker_c, one pool of three yard-hand faces, D-115 DB cast; civ_worker_packer, DB-C2: the packing-table worker, dock_packer), never bank staff. Police are the director roster plus faction reskins.
notes.shadow_ledger: Shadow Ledger (D-115). Every guard and the operator are Northgate Executive Protection, never Halden: one pool of nine faces (npc_northgate_guard a-f, D-116; g-i, D-130: three women, six men) for the reception, rover, stair, roof and operator tags, so Cataclysm's extra guards (about +50 %) + the operator are never twins. Cleaners wear the Calder tabard on both floors, one pool of three faces: npc_cleaner_sl (man, buzz cut), npc_cleaner_sl_b (D-SL-2: woman, late 50s, grey bun), npc_cleaner_sl_c (D-116: young man, glasses), npc_cleaner_sl_d (D-130: woman, late 30s, dark bob; four faces for Cataclysm). Helena Moor is npc_helena_moor; D-130 late_staff (at most one per run, seated desk_work): the K4 executive assistant civ_assistant = npc_km_assistant (woman, early 30s, open slate cardigan, plum blouse, staff lanyard) and the K8 junior associate civ_associate = npc_km_associate (man, late 20s, pale-blue shirt, sleeves rolled, loose burgundy tie, no jacket). Victor Kessler npc_kessler (robe, reading in the bedside armchair: sit_chair_read).
